caption: The video showcases a chocolate-coated ice cream bar standing upright on a white tray, secured in place by a copper binder clip. The scene is set against a plain white background with soft lighting that highlights the texture of the frozen treat. At the beginning of the clip, a small pool of pale yellow melted liquid has already formed around the base of the clip where the stick enters. As the sequence progresses, this puddle expands outward across the surface of the tray, growing wider and more irregular in shape. The ice cream bar itself remains stationary throughout, maintaining its vertical position while condensation droplets cling to the dark brown coating. By the end of the video, the accumulation of melted liquid surrounding the base is noticeably larger than it was initially.
